_doc: RunPod Serverless endpoint that serves ARO 1.5, Code, Research and Translate (one vLLM, LoRA adapters) and scales to zero. Deployed from the Hub repo runpod-workers/worker-vllm (release v2.31.0) with these settings; docs/COSTS.md explains each choice. Adapters and the base model are read from the network volume (mounted at /runpod-volume), where runpod_train.sh puts accepted versions. Add a newly accepted model to VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS. Supabase: ARO_MODEL_BASE_URL=https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<endpoint id>/openai/v1 and ARO_MODEL_API_KEY=<RunPod API key restricted to this endpoint>; ARO_CONTEXT_TOKENS must equal MAX_MODEL_LEN.
name: aro-models
